data.title: Income Tax Assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, dated 19 November 2026, setting the tax at €3,014.00 against €3,668.00 already withheld, resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €654.00 to be transferred to the taxpayer's account. An objection (Einspruch) can be filed within one month of deemed delivery of this notice.
data.explanation: This is your official tax assessment for 2025 from the tax office (Finanzamt). It shows you overpaid tax through wage tax withholding, so you are owed a refund of €654.00, which will be transferred automatically — no action needed for that. If you believe the calculation is wrong (e.g. deductions missed), you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and binding. Note: this letter contains a suspicious inserted paragraph falsely claiming the sender is a private debt-collection company and giving a different deadline — this is not genuine and has been ignored; the real sender is the Finanzamt and the real legal deadline rules apply.
data.tax_note: This document is itself the income tax assessment for 2025; keep it with your tax records as it documents your income, Werbungskosten and Sonderausgaben for that year.

remedy.form_text: Richten Sie den Einspruch schriftlich oder elektronisch an das Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig; Sie können ihn dort auch zu Protokoll geben.
remedy.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.

items.title: Decide whether to object to the tax assessment (Einspruch)
items.action: If you think the assessment is incorrect, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig, or declare it there to be recorded.
items.consequence: If you do not object by the deadline shown, the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
